info.title: API.SH: Immowelt
info.description: The Immowelt API from API.SH: public Immowelt data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.summary: Your calls of the last 30 days
get.description: Newest first. Filter by status, route prefix, key or time; page with `before` (the `next` value). Add output=csv|ndjson to download (up to 5,000 rows per request; the next cursor is in the x-next-cursor header). Free.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: ok, error, or an HTTP status like 502.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Only calls made with this key id.

get.summary: Fetch a past response again, free
get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

200.description: The stored response (headers: x-refetch: 1, x-original-time, x-original-route).

404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

get.description:
An agency on immowelt: profile id, agency id, name, address, logo, partner level, time on immowelt and listing counts (for sale, for rent, new projects, sold, rented); plus its listings of one kind, 20 a page, with the same fields as /immowelt/v1/search (id, title, price, price per m², facts, address, images, link). Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/immowelt-agency

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: An agency profile link (immowelt.de/profil/<id>; the provider link in /immowelt/v1/property), or the id.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Which listings: for sale (default), for rent or new projects.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
immowelt's own place suggestions for a city, district, neighbourhood or postcode: id, name, full label, type and a ready search link. Use the id as `locations` in an immowelt search link.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/immowelt-locations

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
New-build homes (Neubau) in a place on immowelt, to buy or rent, apartments, houses or both: the same listing fields and paging as /immowelt/v1/search. Give a place name or its id from /immowelt/v1/locations. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 2 credits per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/immowelt-new-developments

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Place name (the best city match is used).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
immowelt's price atlas for a place (sale prices per m², euros): average, low and high for apartments, houses and both (with prices by room count or house type), the same a year ago, the price index history (monthly index and listings, yearly prices, 6-month / 1-year / 5-year change), the dearest and cheapest neighbourhoods, prices of nearby cities, neighbourhoods and top streets, and the place's apartments and houses for sale with links.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/immowelt-price-map

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: City slug (e.g. berlin, muenchen, hamburg, koeln), or an immowelt.de/immobilienpreise/... link in `url`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Immowelt listings for a place (locations ids, a place name or postcode as location, or an Immowelt search URL) with filters. When location text is used, `resolved_location` shows the place searched. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 2 credits per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/immowelt-search

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: An Immowelt /classified-search URL. Or give locations and filters.

parameters.name: locations
parameters.description: Immowelt place ids, comma-separated (e.g. AD08DE8634, from an Immowelt search URL). Or give location as text.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: A city, district or postcode as text (e.g. Berlin, Kreuzberg, 80331), used when no locations ids or url place is given: the best matching Immowelt place is searched and returned in `resolved_location` (id, type, label).

parameters.name: property_type
parameters.description: apartment, house, plot, parking, building, office, commercial (comma-separated).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: relevance, newest, oldest, price_asc, price_desc, area_asc, area_desc.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
